findings: De kvällar då pjäsen spelas på svenska är den mörk. -> De flesta kvällar då pjäsen spelas på svenska är den mörk. (passage §7; pre-existing, not repair-introduced. §1 establishes four Swedish-language evenings on which the screen does carry text, and §3 confirms it is the same screen, so the coda as written contradicts the piece's own opening. The piece is otherwise scrupulous with its numbers — 'Raden rymmer fyra kvällar', 'Jag har varit på tre av dem' — which is why the overreach is audible)

Det som återkommer längst ned på varje uppslag är slingans symbol: ”Slingans symbol finns längst ned på varje uppslag i programbladet och har gjort det i alla år.” -> ”Slingans symbol finns längst ned på varje uppslag i programbladet och har gjort det i alla år.” (q2 rationale, option B; NEW copy this round. The paraphrase repeats the quote's own words verbatim two words before quoting them — slingans symbol, längst ned på varje uppslag — so the reader hears the same clause twice)

avvisar, inte det antal raden rymmer: ”Raden rymmer fyra kvällar.” -> avvisar: ”Raden rymmer fyra kvällar.” (q2 rationale, option A; NEW copy this round. Same verbatim stutter — raden rymmer / Raden rymmer, two words apart)

raden står inklämd mellan två andra kategorier i höstprogrammet, och texten säger vilka de är: -> texten säger vilka två kategorier raden ligger mellan: (q2 rationale, key; NEW copy this round. inklämd and höstprogram(met) both land inside the quote that follows immediately after)
justification: Vote 1, read aloud as a native, two sentences either side of every changed span. Both round-1 prescriptions landed and both landed cleanly: 'Det som slingan för fram är ljudet' closes the free relative and the garden path is gone, and 'Längre bak i programbladet' pulls the reader back from the stage to the booklet exactly as the deixis needed. The new surname Hörnfeldt keeps the line's stress. The passage's voice is still the best-carried of the three — 'Ett svepskäl är det inte', 'Om lilla scenen kan bära samma sak vet jag inte', 'den som hör dåligt får ändå rätta sig efter någon annans kalender'. What has gone backwards is the rebuilt q2 rationale, written from scratch this round: three times in one paragraph it says the quote's own words and then quotes them, and read aloud each one stutters. Separately, the coda overstates: after four paragraphs about four subtitled Swedish evenings, a flat claim that the screen is dark on Swedish evenings does not hold, and round 1 praised this line rather than testing it. Flag.

findings: Åtta kvällar är den utbyggnad skribenten målar upp och avvisar, inte det antal raden rymmer -> Åtta kvällar är den utbyggnad som skribenten målar upp och avvisar, inte det antal som raden rymmer (q2 rationale, option A; NEW copy. Two som-less object relatives stacked in one clause chain. Each omission is licit on its own, but the second, 'det antal raden rymmer', reads as a garden path — the eye takes 'antal raden' as one phrase before it has to back up. This is the same construction round 1 flagged in the passage, here in its permitted form but doubled)

B ger raden en plats i bladet som hör till något annat. -> B beskriver inte raden utan slingans symbol. (q2 rationale, option B; NEW copy. The relative 'som hör till något annat' attaches to bladet, the nearest available head, which yields 'the booklet, which belongs to something else' instead of the intended 'a place that belongs to something else')
justification: Vote 2, systematic grammar sweep. Round 1's two items landed: the omitted subject-relative som in §2 is restored, and q1 option D now uses the bare definites lilla scenen / stora scenen that option A and the passage use. Clean on: en/ett (en rad, ett svepskäl, en skärm, ett uppslag, en mottagare, en replik, ett spelår); predicative agreement (inklämd on en rad; 'är den mörk' on skärmen; 'Ett svepskäl är det inte' with the correct neuter predicational det); pronoun gender on every anaphor (den = kostnaden across the paragraph break, den = invändningen, den = repliken, den = skärmen); BIFF at every negation including 'den som vet att remsan går spelar inte som förut', 'för den publiken har inte för mycket' and 'Jag har ännu inte träffat någon som har spelat'; verb morphology in the new option A ('binds' is the standard s-passive present of binda, and bare 'vid manus' is the theatre idiom); prepositions (på rad tre, i T-läge, vid vaktmästeriet, i den takt som, efter pjäs); compounds all established, no coinage; no non-words. Both remaining defects are in the q2 rationale that fleet-repair-1 wrote from scratch, and both are relative-clause faults: two licit som-omissions stacked into a garden path, and one relative that attaches to the wrong head. Flag.

findings: C lägger en uppgift i raden som står på annat håll i bladet: ”Längre bak i programbladet står Ingegerd Hörnfeldt under rubriken Text och teknik.” -> C lägger en uppgift i raden som hör hemma på annat håll: ”Längre bak i programbladet står Ingegerd Hörnfeldt under rubriken Text och teknik.” (q2 rationale, option C; NEW copy. A double echo across the colon — the writer's own står falls twelve words before the quote's står, and bladet twelve words before programbladet)

Det som återkommer längst ned på varje uppslag är slingans symbol: -> (delete; let the quote carry it) (q2 rationale, option B; the paraphrase-in-the-quote's-own-words pattern, which the rebuilt paragraph runs three times: inklämd/höstprogram in the key limb, raden rymmer in A's, slingans symbol + längst ned på varje uppslag in B's)
justification: Vote 3, register and genre. Round 1 passed this unit on this dimension and the passage still earns it: real Swedish debattprosa in a named, situated first person — observation, mechanism, the opponents' case at full strength and conceded, then the demand with its scope fixed, then the things she refuses to ask for. The accessibility register is Swedish rather than translated (hörselslinga, T-läge, syntolkning, textade föreställningar, textremsa, gästspel, spelår), and the sweep finds no English lemma inflected as Swedish, no English metaword, no snake_case, no bracketed label, no rule self-attestation and no bench vocabulary — the rationales say skribenten and texten throughout. The new q1 option A, 'Allt på stora scenen bör textas', is the standard passive of that register and is a genuine paraphrase rather than the near-verbatim lift it replaced. What moves this vote from pass to flag is entirely the rebuilt q2 rationale: a stå echo straddling a colon, bladet against programbladet in the same span, and three paraphrases that reproduce their own quotes word for word. This is a dimension fleet-repair-1 made worse, not better, and it is worth saying plainly. Flag.

findings: Skälet står i meningen efter -> Skälet ges i meningen efter (q1 rationale, key paragraph; NEW, introduced by fleet-repair-1. The colon repair replaced 'och ger skälet i meningen efter' with a fresh finite står that lands twenty-three characters after the quoted 'Hästen fick stå i stallet', with 'Följden står utskriven' following — three stå-forms in one 280-character paragraph where the pre-repair text had two, far apart)

Hovarna klarade sig med broddar i skorna. -> Hovarna klarade sig med broddar. (q1 option B; NEW, rebuilt this round. skorna is a first-mention definite the passage never supplies — it can only bridge from Hovarna to horseshoes — and option A's 'där folk gick' keeps the human reading of skorna live in the same set. Dropping the phrase also takes B off being the set's longest option, which leaves the key tied rather than trailing)
justification: Vote 1, read aloud as a native with two sentences either side of every changed span. All six round-1 prescriptions landed and every one of them improved the sentence it touched: 'kälken drogs för hand' sets up the ski contrast better than 'till fots' did and the q1 rationale's quote moved with it; 'snön förblir torr' removes the verbatim echo of §2 while keeping the physics; 'gå efter sydsluttningarna' resolves the floating dem. The essay's ear is still the best in the batch — the V1 conditionals in §1, 'Veckorna kom när de kom', 'Var gård körde för sig', and the closing two upphöjda ryggar across the mire. The repeated sydsluttningarna in §6 I accept: the repair log discloses it, names it as a disambiguating repetition, and the alternative it replaced was the defect. Two things do stop me, and both are this round's own work: a står planted twenty-three characters after a quoted stå in the key rationale, and a definite skorna in the rebuilt option B that the passage never introduces and that option A's folk makes ambiguous. Flag.

findings: Hovarna klarade sig med broddar i skorna. -> Hovarna klarade sig med broddar. (q1 option B; a definite with no antecedent in the text. It is a licit bridging definite in the abstract — hooves imply horseshoes — but the passage names broddar without ever naming skor, and the competing bridge from option A's folk is live in the same option set)

Texten stryker i stället hindren: -> Texten upphäver i stället hindren: (q2 rationale, option D; NEW copy this round. stryka takes a list, an entry or a line — you stryka något ur en förteckning — not the obstacles themselves; the passage's own idiom is 'räknas varken diken eller gärdsgårdar')
justification: Vote 2, systematic grammar sweep. All three round-1 items landed: the superfluous demonstrative is gone from 'återger skillnaden', 'lägga ut på förhand' is 'bestämma på förhand' and now echoes the stem's 'lades upp', and the att-subordinated capitalised quote is a colon. Clean on: en/ett (ett tryck, en lyftning, ett lyssnande, en skiva, en isskorpa, ett lock, ett lass, en hov, en tallrik, en backe); definiteness (den obrukade åkern, morgonens väg, Olivia Sjödins lada, kälke→kälken as an ordinary introduction chain); predicative and attributive agreement (lämnar snön lös, ett tunt hårt lock, sträv som fint grus, två upphöjda ryggar); BIFF at every negation ('Ett lass som inte är hemma vid tio', 'en väg som inte finns resten av året'); the participle relative 'det som kälkmedarna packat' keeps its som and drops har correctly; prepositions (på håll, fram på dagen, fram emot middagstid, tvärs över, i mitten av mars); compounds established, none coined; no non-words; the glossary defines skare and menföre and both occur. The comparative ellipsis in the rebuilt q2 option D, 'samma vägar som resten av året', I clear — it is the ordinary Swedish temporal comparison, on the pattern of 'samma sak som igår', and it borrows the passage's own phrase. Two defects, both created this round: one unanchored definite in a rebuilt option, one collocation in a rewritten rationale. Flag.

findings: Skälet står i meningen efter -> Skälet ges i meningen efter (q1 rationale; a stå-form pile-up. Three in one paragraph — the quoted 'fick stå i stallet', then står twenty-three characters later, then 'Följden står utskriven'. The middle one is fleet-repair-1's, put there by the colon fix)

därför att ordet står i texten. Det står i en mening som avvisar åtgärden -> därför att ordet finns i texten. Det står i en mening som avvisar åtgärden (q1 rationale, option B; a second står pair nineteen characters apart in the same rationale, which brings it to five stå-forms in one question's copy. Pre-existing — round 1 changed passagen to texten in this clause but left the pair — and the repair log's own n-gram screen rules out the obvious 'står i texten men' repair, which the proposed form avoids)
justification: Vote 3, register and genre. The passage remains the best-written of the three and both round-1 register items landed: 'passagen', the constructor's bench word, is now 'texten', and the shift-scheduling 'lägga ut' is 'bestämma på förhand'. Swept and found nothing on: blog drift, rhetorical-question padding, anglicisms, English lemmas inflected as Swedish, snake_case, bracketed trap labels, rule self-attestation, or the document-reading present standing in for a past. The coda still turns the subject into something looked at rather than used, which is what makes it an essä rather than a description. The repeated sydsluttningarna in §6 is a repeated noun inside the twenty-word window, but it is disclosed in the repair log as a deliberate disambiguation and it replaces a genuinely ambiguous dem, so under the disclosure rule it passes. What does not pass is the stå-form density in q1's rationale: five in one question's copy, in two pairs nineteen and twenty-three characters apart, one of the pairs manufactured by this round's colon repair. Rationales are copy a student reads, so this is not a bench-only concern. Flag.
